title: Bounce the Counting Bunny - Ep1: Ten Carrots

scenes.visual: Wide shot: sunny meadow, Bounce hopping in from left, waves at camera.
scenes.voiceover: Hi friends! I'm Bounce! Today let's count my carrots!

scenes.visual: Bounce points to a carrot patch, one carrot pops up.
scenes.voiceover: One carrot, orange and small, is that really all?

scenes.visual: A second carrot pops up next to it, Bounce hops closer.
scenes.voiceover: Two carrots, side by side, growing with such pride!

scenes.visual: Carrots 3-5 pop up one at a time, Bounce counts each on-screen with a bouncing number graphic.
scenes.voiceover: Three, four, five -- hop, hop, hop! Watch these carrots grow and pop!

scenes.visual: Carrots 6-8 appear, Bounce does a little dance.
scenes.voiceover: Six, seven, eight -- count with me! Look how many we can see!

scenes.visual: Carrots 9-10 appear, full row of 10 carrots on screen with big number '10'.
scenes.voiceover: Nine, then ten -- now let's cheer! Ten yummy carrots, right here!

scenes.visual: Bounce sits and 'eats' happily, wiggles ears.
scenes.voiceover: We counted all the way to ten! Let's count again -- who's with me?

scenes.visual: End card: replay button graphic, Bounce waves.
scenes.voiceover: Bye friends! See you next time!
